numerical_errors: In _compute_kernel, the check 'if self.is_surjective()' fails for infinite FpGroups because is_surjective() returns None when both image and codomain are infinite, causing the code to fall through to the infinity check and raise NotImplementedError
In _surjective_fp_kernel, the validation 'if not self.is_surjective()' will incorrectly raise ValueError when is_surjective() returns None for infinite groups, since 'not None' evaluates to True
